responsibility: This file is the main implementation of GCC’s internal-function subsystem, the call-like IR abstraction used for compiler-synthesized operations. It builds metadata tables from internal-fn.def, supports name lookup and fnspec initialization, classifies memory and masked/gather/scatter forms, queries target support for direct internal functions, and most importantly contains many of the expanders that lower IFN calls from GIMPLE to target RTL via optabs, target hooks, and direct patterns. Its responsibility is the executable semantics and expansion policy of IFN_* operations, distinct from the declarative lists in internal-fn.def and the declarations in internal-fn.h.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/internal-fn.def, which is the X-macro catalogue of IFN_* entries, and gcc/internal-fn.h, which only declares the interface and metadata accessors, this file builds the runtime tables from that catalogue and implements the support checks, classification helpers, and GIMPLE-to-RTL expansion behavior for internal functions.
